items.name: Ledger Page: The Trophy Hold: text (Pays line names the Haul chests)

data.description:
A page torn from the Arsenal Keeper's ledger: hides, horn and the hunters' prizes, sealed below the gun deck.

The Trophy Hold · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★★★★☆
Pays: the Keeper's stores, from a Hide Bundle up to the Keeper's Reserve
Up to 5 steps: a crate (a chest and a fight), a sealed locker (a better chest, a harder fight and a hazard) or cut through (no fight, a hazard next). Here: lockers at every step; cut through at steps 3–4. Leave after any step.
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by taking your haul, falling or abandoning. Lose a fight and you leave with nothing.
